newsitem.title: USA: Dean Witter to fire 200 in Morgan merger.
newsitem.headline: Dean Witter to fire 200 in Morgan merger.

text.p: Dean Witter, Discover & Co said Friday that as part of its merger with Morgan Stanley Group Inc it is eliminating about 200 employees from its investment banking and research staffs following completion of the merger in mid-1997.
The company said that 14 employees had been notifed Friday that they would be fired, but described the severance packages as "comensurate with industry standards."
The company also said that over 150 professionals from its investment banking, research and institutional equities staffs would join Morgan Stanley, pending consummation of the merger.

Dean Witter also said that it is expanding its brokerage operations in New York City by opening three new offices in Manhattan during 1997, including one at Morgan Stanley headquarters. The company said those offices will be staffed by 250 employees.
